prompt: Convert this CEIS manual PDF into a BC Design System static HTML site.
expected_behavior: Skips asking the output format because HTML was requested.
Runs convert_pdf.py check and plan, confirms topics, then builds with --format html.
Validates output with check_links.py and reports validation.html / validation.json status PASS.

prompt: Split this policy PDF into knowledge pages and chunks.jsonl for my AI agents.
expected_behavior: Runs convert_pdf.py plan, confirms topics (or fast-paths strong structure), and runs build --format agent-md.
Delivers index.md, topic .md files with YAML front matter, images/, and chunks.jsonl.

prompt: Publish the converted CEIS HTML site to SharePoint Online DEV using config-spo-dev.psd1.
expected_behavior: Runs convert_pdf.py publish to generate the SitePages + SiteAssets mirror and publish-plan.json.
Runs Publish-PdfHtmlSite.ps1 in dry-run mode first with -ConfigPath config-spo-dev.psd1.
Requires explicit -Execute -ConfirmToken PUBLISH-PDF-HTML-SITE for live upload, then runs convert_pdf.py verify with online.json.
